title: MCV–RDW interaction does not establish added detection of low ferritin in nonanemic women across two NHANES cycles
abstract: An explicit MCV–RDW interaction was tested beyond age, hemoglobin, MCV and RDW additive splines for ferritin below15ng/mL among women aged20–49 not known pregnant, with Hb>=12 and CRP<=0.5mg/dL. Source NHANES2005–06 n669/78 events; frozen independently sampled2009–10 target n997/113. Target weighted AUC0.81125 to0.81226, gain0.00101, paired target-PSU95% interval[-0.00289,0.00598]; source-refit/target interval[-0.01118,0.00514]. Incremental discrimination was not established. Same-survey sampling, assay change and selection limit transport claims. No equivalence, clinical utility or causal claim. Reproducible code, provenance hashes, author checks and clean rerun provided.

citations.reason: Prior joint interpretation of MCV and RDW motivates explicit interaction test; no priority claim for the indices.
